% Generated by robodojo_3d_plot.py --paper. Copy the PDF into the paper's figures/ directory (or change the path). Needs graphicx.
\begin{figure}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/robodojo-3d-frontier.pdf}
  \caption{\textbf{Cost, speed and score Pareto frontier on RoboDojo-RC Tier~1.} Each point is one model configuration (M/H/XH: medium, high and extra-high reasoning effort; UF: ultrafast serving), placed by its API cost per subtask, subtask completion rate (subtasks per hour of wall-clock time) and mean task score over 120 attempts, all on log axes, with a drop line to the floor. Cost and rate are ratios of totals (summed cost over the subtasks completed, and subtasks completed over summed minutes, an attempt judged at milestone $k$ of its task completing $k$ subtasks), so attempts that completed no subtask still count. The surface is the Pareto frontier: at each cost and rate, the best score of any configuration that is at most that costly and at least that fast. Filled markers are the 9 Pareto-optimal configurations; hollow markers are dominated (another configuration is at least as good on all three axes and better on one).}
  \label{fig:pareto-3d}
\end{figure}
